title: USR Hindi-English Corpus: Universal Semantic Representations with English references and gold chunks, and the usr2chunk generator
description: Gold corpus of 2,071 Hindi Universal Semantic Representations (tourism, health, geography) with English references and gold chunks, Telugu data and agreement data, together with the usr2chunk rule-based generator and all evaluation scripts. Data: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (research use only, citation required). Code: MIT.
